_note: GitHub archive FortAwesome/Font-Awesome at the release tag (no `v` prefix), narrowed to svgs/: only the Free solid, regular and brands folders, no Pro files, no kit code. Sanitise runs strict and report-only: Font Awesome's licence asks that the `<!--! Font Awesome Free ... -->` attribution comment stay in every file, and removing it is the policy's only change to these files, so report-only keeps upstream bytes while strict still fails the run on a real violation. The licence is Font Awesome's own text, pinned by SHA-256. Reproduces the committed pack byte for byte: a dry run at the pinned version against the local checkout on 2026-11-04 wrote 2,883 SVGs with 0 added, removed or changed.
name: icon-sets-font-awesome-free
